description: This file defines the EmployeeEducationDecorator class within the OrangeHRM project. It provides methods to manipulate EmployeeEducation entities, such as setting associated Employee and Education objects by their identifiers, and formatting start/end dates.

classes.name: EmployeeEducationDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class for EmployeeEducation entity, providing methods for setting associated entities and formatting date fields.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that receives an EmployeeEducation object to decorate.

methods.name: setEmployeeByEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the Employee associated with the EmployeeEducation based on the employee number.

methods.name: setEducationByEducationId
methods.description: Sets the Education associated with EmployeeEducation based on the education ID.

methods.name: getStartDate
methods.description: Returns the start date of the education as a formatted string.

methods.name: getEndDate
methods.description: Returns the end date of the education as a formatted string.
